R3A-bear-backcountry-0001.name: By Texas Creek
R3A-bear-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R3A-bear-backcountry-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Texas Creek (paved road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2011 (15 years old), right here: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
SE facing slope, 22 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Texas Creek 80 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Texas Creek. Closed April 15 to November 30. Synopsis map 1-62/23.

plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 122 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 99, Lillooet River Rd, Hwy 99 (Lillooet Lake Rd), Texas Creek Rd.
Park: 50.53713, -121.8368, pull off on Texas Creek (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 8.9 km SW, on Texas Creek. Climb about 75 m, about 185 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 360 m NE of the spot at 1,177 m (50.48897, -121.91397). Water: Texas Creek 40 m NW (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-16, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-27, closures 2026-10-16.
R3A-bear-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 3-16: about 183 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.06 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
5 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
31 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 122 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 99, Lillooet River Rd, Hwy 99 (Lillooet Lake Rd), Texas Creek Rd.
Park: 50.53734, -121.83758, pull off on Texas Creek (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk 6.4 km to the start. Walk: the Texas Creek stretch, 6.1 km one way. About 122 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-16, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
